resolved_conflicts.explanation: Idaho Heritage Trust gives 1929 as an R4 Plan 80. NHLR, firelookout.com, Idaho Fire Lookouts and the local history page give 1934 for the L-4 cab. The story uses 1934 and reports the 1929 claim.
NHLR and the local history page say 2002. Idaho Fire Lookouts lists 2002 in its timeline but its text calls it the 2003 restoration. The story uses 2002 and notes the disagreement.
firelookout.com says last used for emergencies in 1960. NHLR and Idaho Fire Lookouts say the 1960s. The story gives both.
NHLR gives 6,280 ft (1,914 m). Idaho Fire Lookouts gives 6354 feet. The record keeps 1914.1 m from NHLR.

notes_for_editor: Built date conflicts (1929 vs 1934); story uses 1934. Rental status unconfirmed: firelookout.com says planned; forest camping page lists one unnamed lookout. Access is unknown in the record and no visit info was found, so no access block. Search results also showed a different Granite Mountain Lookout on the Payette NF (NHLR, 1955 L-4 tower) and one on Mount Baker-Snoqualmie; neither is this record and neither was read.
